On 14 October 2024, in Rio de Janeiro - West Zone (Rio de Janeiro), three CV drug traffickers tortured and injured a woman for more than seven hours in the Jordao community, Jacarepagua neighborhood. Her husband (who has a record of drug trafficking) had assaulted her and then sent traffickers to kidnap her and kill her. The traffickers tied her feet and hands behind her back and put a collar around her neck. She was tortured with a plastic bag over her head, beaten and forced to walk around the community. After a few hours, they poured gasoline on the victim's body, saying they were going to kill her. She managed to escape and was captured again. At that point, they threw her off a hill, but she survived and called for help. The woman has bruises on her knees, wrists, feet and cuts on her head. There were no fatalities.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Candelaria (Santa Cruz), a group of Indigenous and farmers, members of the Base Territorial Organization (OTB), carried out a demonstration by blocking the road between Santa Cruz and San Ignacio de Velasco municipalities, demanding the tendering for the construction of a drinking water project in the locality. The group denounced drinking water shortage in previous years due to the limited infrastructure that the community has.

On 26 May 2025, in Bulo Bulo (Cochabamba), coca farmers assaulted with rocks and firecrackers a group of military officers after an operation against drug trafficking in the region, where the officers destroyed infrastructure for processing coca. There were no casualties.

On 26 May 2025, in Cobija (Pando), public official transport carried out a demonstration by blocking the access to four service stations at the Internacional Avenue, affecting the transit to the border area with Brazil, denouncing fuel shortage and demanding greater supply for the department and the decentralization of the Bolivian Oil Fields (YPFB).

On 26 May 2025, in Cochabamba (Cochabamba), hundreds of merchants at local markets carried out a pot-banging demonstration and marched through the main streets of the city towards 14 de Septiembre square, rejecting increase in food prices, fuel and dollar shortage and demanding solutions from local and national authorities.

source: El Diario (Bolivia); La Patria en Linea; Opinion (Bolivia)
notes: On 26 May 2025, in La Paz (La Paz), small-business owners from El Alto carried out a demonstration by marching through the main streets of the city and gathered outside the department of communication, denouncing increase in raw material prices, lack of assistance and measures from national authorities to support the sector, devaluation of the Bolivian currency and increase in the dollar price. The group demanded the closure of state-owned companies engaging in unfair competition, the closure of borders to smuggled goods and tax amnesty.

On 26 May 2025, in Mineros (Santa Cruz), cargo transporters carried out a demonstration by blocking a road in the municipality (unspecified), demanding fuel and diesel supply. The group denounced they have not been able to work for several weeks due to fuel shortage.

On 26 May 2025, in Santa Cruz de la Sierra (Santa Cruz), workers at the Departmental Road Services (Sedcam) gathered outside the governor's office to demonstrate, denouncing poor management of the Sedcam and calling for the dismissal of the head of the entity. Demonstrators denounced lack of resources for the entity's operation and violation of working rights.

source: El Deber; La Patria en Linea
notes: On 26 May 2025, in Tarija (Tarija), a large group of residents and merchants carried out a demonstration by marching through the main streets of the city, rejecting increase in food and other goods prices and denouncing lack of actions from national authorities to tackle the economic crisis the country is undergoing. The group demanded the resignation of the directors of the Food Production Support Company (EMAPA), the National Agricultural Health and Food Safety Service (Senasag) and of regional customs authorities, denouncing irregularities in the administration and distribution of food products.

On 26 May 2025, in Villa Yapacani (Santa Cruz), cargo transporters carried out a demonstration by blocking the road between Santa Cruz and Cochabamba departments at the entrance of Villa Yapacani, demanding fuel and diesel supply. The group denounced they have not been able to work for several weeks due to fuel shortage. The blockade was lifted later the same day.

On 26 May 2025, in La Paz (La Paz), residents from the Distrito 13 neighborhood in El Alto municipality, carried out a demonstration by marching through the main streets of La Paz, protesting against increase in prices and demanded measures from national authorities.

On 26 May 2025, in Warnes (Santa Cruz), residents carried out a demonstration by marching through the main streets of city, rejecting increase in prices and fuel and dollar shortage. They demanded solutions from local and national authorities.

The police were called after a man cursed at people in an establishment and insisted on entering the place wearing slippers, which was forbidden. Officers engaged in physical combat with the man, and even after he surrendered, officers continued to beat him with punches and kicks. There were no fatalities.

actor1: Military Forces of Brazil (2023-) Military Police
notes: On 26 May 2025, in Atibaia (Sao Paulo), the Military Police exchanged fire with a suspect drug trafficker in the Caetuba neighborhood. Officers were patrolling the area when they approached a man with an outstanding arrest warrant for drug trafficking. According to the police, the man resisted arrest, which led to a riot among local residents, and a police officer fired a shot into the air. An officer applied a rear choke which has been banned in the military since 2020. One of the police officers was punched in the face, while the other was hit in the back of the head with a stone. There were no fatalities.

Police seized firearms and ammunition. 3 fatalities.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Jundiai (Sao Paulo), the Military Highway Police exchanged fire with a suspected drug trafficker in the Vila Nambi neighborhood. According to the Public Security Secretariat, the police were patrolling the area when a suspect, upon noticing the presence of the team, fled into a building. The officers followed him to the location and were met with gunfire. The officers fired back and shot and killed him. Agents seized drugs, money and a firearm. 1 fatality.

Agents arrested one man and seized a Taurus G3C 9mm pistol, a magazine with seven rounds of ammunition, a radio transmitter and a cell phone from him. There were no casualties.

Another suspect, who also tried to flee, was arrested in the act in a wooded area. Agents seized weapons, drugs and money. 1 fatality.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Torixoreu (Mato Grosso), two CV members exchanged fire with military police during an operation in the Castro Alves neighborhood. Both CV members were killed. Police seized two firearms and portions of drugs. 2 fatalities.

On 26 May 2025, in the rural area of Lagoa da Canoa municipality (Alagoas), two unidentified armed suspects shot and killed a man in the Vila Mata Limpa area. The suspects arrived at the location in a vehicle and broke into the victim's house, where they shot and killed him. The suspects escaped immediately. The authorship and motivations for the attack are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Porto Alegre (Rio Grande do Sul), a man was killed and his burnt body was found in the trunk of a burnt car in the Lomba do Pinheiro neighborhood. Police suspect the victim was killed in the context of drug trafficking disputes. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Novo Hamburgo (Rio Grande do Sul), locals beat up and injured a man suspected of child sexual abuse. The suspect also had a record for drug trafficking. Emergency responders took the suspect to a hospital.

On 26 May 2025, in Sao Paulo - Central Zone (Sao Paulo), unidentified men threw a grenade into an occupation by the Front for the Struggle for Housing (FLM) on General Osorio Street in the Republica neighborhood. With the bomb still intact inside the building, the men remained outside, cursing the homeless protesters. The Military Police went to the scene and so did supporters of the occupation. After about two hours, the block was cordoned off by the bomb squad, which carried out the procedure and imploded the artifact. There were no casualties.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Sao Paulo - East Zone (Sao Paulo), residents of the Jorge Hereda and Terra Prometida occupations demonstrated for better housing and against evictions. Participants set fire to barricades and marched along, closing a stretch of Aricanduva Avenue, in the direction of Marginal Tiete. At the exact moment when the demonstrators had agreed to end the demonstration, the military police intervened and dropped stun bombs.

On 26 May 2025, in Jacarei (Sao Paulo), Jacarei City Hall employees protested for a pay rise and marched through the streets of the center to the city hall. The action took place during a work strike. The strike was ended after a meeting with the city hall on the same day, where it was agreed that the workers would present a list of demands and the city hall would analyze the requests.

On 26 May 2025, in Joao Pessoa (Paraiba), motorcycle couriers and family members protested in the Manaira neighborhood to denounce the release of a man accused of killing a motorcyclist in a 2021 hit-and-run incident. The suspect was recently transferred to a semi-open regime, and the group demanded his immediate return to prison on a closed regime.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Sao Paulo - West Zone (Sao Paulo), around 100 residents of the Areiao community demonstrated against the repossession of their land and demanded better housing conditions. The demonstrators closed several points of the road with barricades and burning objects, including the train tracks. Two other neighboring communities, from the city of Osasco, joined the act. The action slowed down traffic in the area. The demonstration was repressed by the Shock Battalion of the Sao Paulo State Military Police, which used pepper spray and rubber bullets against the population; residents, including children and the elderly, were injured.

source: Alma Preta Jornalismo; G1; O Globo
notes: On 26 May 2025, in Rio de Janeiro - South Zone (Rio de Janeiro), street vendors protested against the City Hall's new rules on Rio's beaches, such as a ban of live music, on Atlantica Avenue on the Copacabana beach. The workers used banners and blocked two roads in the area, causing traffic to be diverted. This is the group's second protest, the first act was at the public hearing in the Chamber of Councilors on 20 May 2025 (coded separately).

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Boituva (Sao Paulo), municipal guards shot and killed a man during a police approach on Joao de Camargo Avenue. According to the Municipal Guards' report, the suspect tried to pull a firearm from his waistband, which was later identified as a replica. The victim was also a prison escapee. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Codajas (Amazonas), a man was killed by unknown individuals and his body was found in the Moadir Colonia region with signs of torture. The circumstances of death are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Esmeraldas (Minas Gerais), a man was killed by unknown individuals and his burnt body was found in the backseat of a burnt car on the BR-040 highway. The body had his hands tied up. The circumstances of death are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Manhuacu (Minas Gerais), a man was killed by unknown individuals and his body was found with gunshot and stab wounds. The victim was a drug user. The circumstances of death are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Santa Rita (Paraiba), unidentified armed suspects shot and killed a man in a drive-by shooting. The suspects were in a vehicle when they fired around 10 times against the victim and escaped immediately. The victim had a police record (charges unspecified). The authorship and motivations for the attack are unknown. 1 fatality.

Other: On 26 May 2025, in Rio de Janeiro - North Zone (Rio de Janeiro), gunshots were heard in the Anchieta, Sampaio, Riachuelo, Cascadura, Andarai, Quintino Bocaiuva, Vicente de Carvalho, Madureira and Engenho da Rainha neighborhoods. Casualties unknown.
Other: On 26 May 2025, in Rio de Janeiro - West Zone (Rio de Janeiro), gunshots were heard in the Bangu and Jacarepagua neighborhoods. Casualties unknown.

He is one of 25 principals who have been called up for a training course by the City Hall. In practice, the call-up represents the dismissal of civil servants without due legal process. On 26 May 2025, in Sao Paulo - West Zone (Sao Paulo), the community of the Ibrahim Nobre Municipal Elementary School, in the Rio Pequeno neighborhood, held a demonstration against the dismissal of the school's principal. Other schools also held protests in the capital (coded separately).

On 26 May 2025, in Natal (Rio Grande do Norte), mothers and family members of children with autism protested to demand access to proper treatment and to denounce the lack of care provided by the healthcare company Hapvida.
On 26 May 2025, in Rio Branco (Acre), residents of the Castelo Branco housing complex blocked streets to protest against the installation of a shelter for the homeless in the neighborhood.
On 26 May 2025, in Cutias (Amapa), two members of a drug trafficking group chased after, shot and killed a member from a rival group. Police detained both suspects. 1 fatality.

notes: On 26 May 2025, in Valparaiso (Valparaiso), eight hooded students at the University of Valparaiso (UV) sought to occupy its faculty of architecture as part of strike action and protests namely in response to the academic vice-chancellor's announcement that teaching would be resumed on 26 May whether or not students attended. The eight students broke into the building near the junction between Gran Bretana and Diagonal Streets but were arrested by police after they were suspected of committing a robbery.

source: El Mercurio Valparaiso; La Estrella De Valparaiso
notes: On 26 May 2025, in Valparaiso (Valparaiso), unionized workers at the Local Public Education Service (SLEP) protested outside their offices to express discontent with around a dozen cases of direct hiring circumventing regular public worker hiring procedures. Protesters, who demanded investigations into the cases, argued that the practice (known colloquially as 'pituto') damaged public service delivery and was an expression of contempt towards them.

On 26 May 2025, in Copiapo (Atacama), students occupied the Liceo Fernando Ariztia school after a fellow pupil who was the victim of bullying went missing the day prior. Protesters demanded the dismissal of the member of staff responsible for harmonious school relations ('convivencia escolar'), the implementation of relevant protocols and updates to the school's code of conduct. Students occupied the school until 28 May. The missing pupil was located on 27 May.

On 26 May 2025, in Puerto Montt (Los Lagos), mainly women students at the Colegio Salesiano school protested with banners in the school's courtyard following allegations that a priest (also the school's director) had sexually harassed a fellow pupil. Students refused to attend classes.

source: El Dia (Chile); La Region de Coquimbo
notes: Weapons seizure: On 26 May 2025, in Cerrillos de Tamaya (Coquimbo), police seized 15 homemade explosive devices, of which five contained shrapnel, as well as fuses and detonators, at a property near Tamaya Mount. The seizure took place after investigative police (PDI) followed up on a reported armed robbery at the house on 27 January.

On 26 May 2025, in Santiago - Nunoa (Metropolitana), teachers gathered at the intersection of Avenida Irarrazabal and Manuel de Salas then moved to Plaza Nunoa to protest better working conditions. The protesters represented 18 municipal schools that began an indefinite strike associated with their labor demands. They demanded staff and payment increases.

On 26 May 2025, in Alto Hospicio (Tarapaca), legal guardians of pupils at the Colegio Macaya school protested outside to demand that its management take concrete measures to prevent alleged violence and sexual abuse perpetrated by a student. Protesters namely demanded the removal of the perpetrator. Legal guardians had filed twelve complaints within the past year.

On 26 May 2025, in Bogota - Usme (Bogota, D.C.), residents of the Santa Librada and the Marichuela neighborhoods and relatives of a teenage boy killed in unclear circumstances gathered at the intersection of Caracas Avenue with Calle 76B Sur blocking the La Dignidad overpass in protest, demanding justice for him and urging authorities to expedite the investigation.

On 26 May 2025, in Cuestecitas (Albania, La Guajira), residents of the Villa Linda neighborhood blocked the road leading to Riohacha to protest stagnant water accumulation and the lack of access to a proper water supply system. The protesters claimed that the stagnant water has had negative impacts on the community's health. The blockade was lifted after five hours, following agreements reached with local authorities.

On 26 May 2025, near La Felisa (La Merced, Caldas), protesters blocked the Manizales-Medellin road near the La Felisa Bridge to demand improvements in road infrastructure and signage to help prevent traffic accidents. The protest was sparked by the death of a motorcyclist who was run over by a trailer on 22 May in the area.

On 26 May 2025, in Malambo (Atlantico), dozens of residents of the El Carmen vereda protested outside the offices of Aguas de Malambo to demand access to clean drinking water. The protesters claimed that the company had failed to honor recent agreements, including a commitment to formally connect the village to the municipal water supply system.

source: Diario Extra (Ecuador); Ecuavisa; El Diario (Ecuador); El Universo (Ecuador)
notes: On 26 May 2025, in Manta (Manabi), an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals (described as hitmen) in a car shot and killed a woman in a drive-by shooting in the La Floreana and Maria Auxiliadora neighbourhood. It is suspected the killings were related to drug trafficking and one woman, a member of Los Lobos gang, was arrested. The authorship is unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Guayaquil - Pascuales (Guayas), members of the Los Tiguerones gang kidnapped a couple, tied them, and beat them up in the Flor de Bastion sector. The victims were taken to a house in the El Fortin neighbourhood. The man was released on the same day and the woman was rescued by the police on 27 May. There is no further information available.
On 26 May 2025, in El Empalme (Guayas), an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals kidnapped two men aboard a taxi. There is no further information available.

On 26 May 2025, in El Pangui (Zamora Chinchipe), two unidentified armed individuals shot and killed a man inside the Billar Bar, between the Mirador and 24 de Mayo neighbourhoods. The authorship and motivations are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Manta (Manabi), an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals (described as hitmen) shot and killed a man in the Piedra Larga resort. It is suspected the attack was a case of settling of scores. The authorship is unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Montalvo (Los Rios), two unidentified armed individuals (described as hitmen) shot and killed a man ear the Dos Corazones tolerance centre, La Vina area. The authorship and motivations are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in El Empalme (Guayas), police forces exchanged gunfire with an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals involved in a kidnapping earlier (coded separately). Two victims were rescued but the perpetrators escaped. There were no casualties.

On 26 May 2025, in Portoviejo (Manabi), several unidentified armed individuals shot and injured a man inside his house in the El Floron 5 neighbourhood. The authorship and motivations are unknown. There were no fatalities.

On 26 May 2025, in Las Balsas (Montalvo, Los Rios), two unidentified armed individuals on a motorbike (described as hitmen) shot and killed a private security guard in a drive-by shooting in El Salto parish. The victim was shot at least eight times and it was not specified if he was working at the time. The authorship and motivations are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Huaquillas (El Oro), police officers exchanged gunfire with two members of the Los Lobos gang in the 9 de Octubre neighbourhood, at the intersection of 19 de Octubre and 12 de Octubre Avenues. Two suspects were injured and were arrested. There were no fatalities.

On 26 May 2025, in Guayaquil - Pascuales (Guayas), an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals shot and killed a woman in the Flor de Bastion neighbourhood. The victim was a drug user and she was shot in the head and legs. The authorship and motivations are unknown. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Guayaquil - Ximena (Guayas), an unknown number of unidentified armed individuals on a motorbike (described as hitmen) shot and killed a man in a drive-by shooting in the Independencia I cooperative, Isla Trinitaria neighbourhood. The victim worked at the port and was leaving work when he was shot. According to authorities, city port employees are being targeted for not allowing drugs into containers to be shipped to other countries. The authorship and motivations are unknown. 1 fatality.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), in Huaquillas (El Oro), a man was killed and his beheaded body was found inside a garbage bag in the 12 de Octubre neighbourhood. The head was in another bag and police found threatening pamphlets next to the body. It is suspected the attack was a case of settling of scores. The number of perpetrators and authorship are unknown. 1 fatality.

The soldiers used a controlled detonation to destroy several pieces of equipment like excavators, fuel tanks and others. There were no arrests.

On 26 May 2025, in Puerto Bolivar (Machala, El Oro), two unidentified armed individuals on a motorbike threw an explosive device inside the Bombonera nightclub and the explosion killed a man and left five other people injured. 1 fatality.

On 26 May 2025, in Pichincha (Manabi), four unidentified armed individuals shot and injured a police officer. All four suspects were arrested and a police patrol vehicle was shot multiple times. Police seized vehicles, ammunition, and drugs. There were no fatalities.

Around 26 May 2025 (as reported), near Presidente Franco (Alto Parana), parents and Indigenous students protested at Basic School No. 6812 Puerto Flores to demand the assignment of a teacher to the institution.

The protesters denounced termite infestation, broken desks, and parts of the roof on the verge of collapse.

On 26 May 2025, in Asuncion (Asuncion), members of organizations such as Somos Pytyvohara gathered in front of Congress to call for an annual march against the abuse and sexual exploitation of girls, boys, and adolescents, scheduled for 31 May. The participants repudiated that ten reports of sexual abuse are filed daily and that, in response, the State must guarantee appropriate protection measures for the victims.

On 26 May 2025, in Huancayo (Junin), neighbors of an elderly woman who was run over and killed days earlier at the intersection of Arequipa and Ferrocarril Avenues, gathered at the same location to demonstrate, demanding justice for the killing of the woman and demanding traffic lights and speed bumps in the sector.

Around 28 May 2025 (as reported), in La Planchada (Arequipa), around 30 fishers carried out a demonstration by blocking the Panamericana Sur highway with tires and other objects, rejecting the closure of fishing docks in the district and denouncing privatization plans of the premises. Demonstrators argued that the docks are their only source of income.

On 28 May 2025, in Caraveli (Arequipa), informal groups of miners clashed with each other with rocks and other objects, after one of the groups tried to access a mining site in the AR-104 road, which has been blocked by the rival group. At least nine people resulted severely injured and a vehicle was set on fire. There were no fatalities.

On 28 May 2025, in Atico (Arequipa), around 150 informal miners from Caraveli municipality carried out a demonstration by blocking the Panamericana Sur highway, demanding police presence in Caraveli after a clash between the group and another informal group of miners (coded separately) and residents. The group demanded local and national authorities intervention and the declaration of state of emergency due to constant clashes.

On 28 May 2025, between Tacna and Palca (Tacna), police forces shot and killed a man driving a car at Km. 38, between both municipalities. The officers argued the victim was shot after he resisted an inspection against smuggling and tried to flee. The officers chased after the vehicle and shot the victim in the back. The victim's relatives denied the victim had any links with smuggling activities and demanded justice for the killing. The officers were later arrested. 1 fatality.

On 28 May 2025, in Pataz (La Libertad), miners, peasant patrol (ronda campesina), and social organizations carried out a demonstration at Vista Florida, demanding the derogation of a national decree (060-2025), which suspended mining activities in the province for 30 days after the killing of 13 miners weeks earlier.
